Rsvp.title: Rsvp
Rsvp.description: A guest RSVP submission for Racheal Kache's December 4, 2026 graduation celebration.

fullName.description: Full name of the responding guest.

email.description: Contact email address of the responding guest (PII, host-readable only).

attending.description: Whether the guest accepts or declines the invitation.

guests.description: Number of guests attending (1 to 4 when accepting, 0 when declining).

message.description: Optional congratulatory message or note for Racheal.

language.description: Language active when the guest submitted the RSVP.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the RSVP was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the RSVP was last updated.

/rsvps/{rsvpId}.description: Collection of guest RSVP submissions. Public write-only dropbox for creating strictly validated RSVPs; read, list, update, and delete are restricted exclusively to the verified host (kacheracheal152@gmail.com).
